sara-support: Customer A reported a spike in tail latency (p95/p99) on the embeddings endpoint and some 400s. They flipped on client-priority tags yesterday.
ajay-engr: ugh. does the error correlate with heavy small-req churn? priority can preempt dynbatch slots.
mike-ml: what model/embedding dims are they hitting?
sara-support: model=embed-large-v2, expected dims=1536. Customer sent mixed payloads — most fine but a few requests show dims=768 (old client). They saw both latency spikes and a handful of 400 responses claiming dim mismatch.
ken-ops: sounds like two issues: dim-mismatch 400s and dynamic-batching tail latency due to preemption/slot fragmentation.
elaine-cs: customer says spikes started after enabling priority tags for mobile clients — they bleed into production traffic.
ajay-engr: can you grab a dump of the batcher events for that timeframe? /var/log/batcher/events.log or the runtime tracing UI.
infra-bot: collect run: batcher.dump --since 2026-03-15T10:05Z --route embeddings --out /tmp/batcher-dump-1775556666.json
sara-support: attached (excerpt):
```
[10:05:12.234] batch_start id=abc slot=0 target_size=64 max_batch=256 priority=normal
[10:05:12.236] enqueue req=R1 size=1024 dims=1536 priority=normal
[10:05:12.237] enqueue req=R2 size=64 dims=1536 priority=mobile
[10:05:12.237] preempt slot=0 by req=R2 (priority=mobile) preempt_timeout=50ms
[10:05:12.290] flush slot=0 size=64 effective_batch=2 latency_p99=820ms
[10:05:12.295] req=R3 dims=768 -> 400 DIM_MISMATCH
```
ajay-engr: that log is telling — a small high-priority request preempted a slot assembling a large request, causing the large req to be pushed into a later smaller batch (or fragmented) and increasing tail latency. plus a bad-client with 768 dims triggered 400s when it joined the batch.
mike-ml: embedding runtime can't coerce mixed-dimension requests in the same batch; we gate by dims.
ken-ops: mitigation options:
- short term: disable priority preemption on embeddings route or raise preempt_timeout so in-flight larger batches complete.
- short term: set max_batch_size lower for the route so large single reqs don't get fragmented as badly (tradeoff: throughput cost).
- fix customer: upgrade their client to 1536 dims or reject earlier with clearer 4xx message in gateway.
elaine-cs: customer asks for actionable repro steps to validate config changes.
ajay-engr: repro steps I used locally (share with customer):
1) run the synthetic generator to mimic mixed sizes: `python tools/emb-load.py --model embed-large-v2 --pattern mix --rate 200 --small-size 64 --large-size 1024 --duration 2m`
2) enable priority tags for a subset: `--priority-client mobile` (generator supports it)
3) tail the batcher events: `batcher.watch --route embeddings`
4) observe p95/p99 and look for preempt events and DIM_MISMATCH 400s
curl example to reproduce single-dim-bad-client:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": ["x"], "model": "embed-large-v2" , "client_dims_override": 768 }'
```
(we used a small harness that injects a wrong-dim header to trigger the gateway path)
sara-support: customer tried the generator and saw the p99 jump from 120ms -> ~800ms within minutes.
ken-ops: one config patch we can push to prod for quick relief: disable priority_preempt for embeddings route. I can submit a canary rollout to two pods and monitor.
ajay-engr: additional durable fix: change batcher semantics to avoid preempting slots that already contain requests exceeding X% of target_size. Eg require preempt only if current_slot_size < target_size*0.25. That avoids fragmenting large requests.
mike-ml: also adding a dims-gating earlier (API gateway) to immediately reject mismatched-dim requests with clearer message and increment a client-facing error counter so support can notify customers automatically.
elaine-cs: can we also create a support-runbook snippet for customers: quick checks and recommended config? will help avoid re-escalations.
ken-ops: I'll open infra change: CHG-2026-4472 - canary disable priority_preempt on embeddings, monitor 10m then rollback/expand. also add banner alert to SRE channel.
infra-bot: canary rollout created: rollout.id=rb-2026-4472-canary pods=2 target=prod-embeddings, watch: https://infra/redwood/rollouts/rb-2026-4472-canary
sara-support: sent customer the repro steps and offered to coordinate a short window to test the canary. they accepted.
ajay-engr: follow-up items:
- ops: run canary and collect p95/p99 and batcher logs for 30m (post-change window)
- eng: PR for batching preempt threshold (spec + unit tests)
- cs: send customer clear guidance for client upgrade + temporary mitigation (disable priority_preempt)
mike-ml: i'll draft the dims-gating gateway patch and an explanatory error body for 400s.
elaine-cs: thanks all. marking this thread as escalated -> eng-oncall until we see canary metrics. :thumbsup:
sara-support: closing the support ticket as "monitoring canary" and will re-open if customer sees issues after canary is rolled out.
